title: Create UI checkbox component
description: Design and implement checkbox in frontend for context selection

instructions.tara: Test the checkbox UI component in various states (checked, unchecked, disabled). Ensure it works with keyboard navigation.
instructions.devon: Create a checkbox component in Vue that toggles between full context and minimal context. Use Tailwind for styling.
instructions.orion: Review the UI component for accessibility and usability. Suggest improvements.

notes: The checkbox should be intuitive and accessible.
key_considerations: Consistent styling with the rest of the UI
